claycode.summary: Separate structural module linking from eager value initialization; do not add syntax yet; implement/test canonical eager-dependency planning and fail-closed cycle receipts in compiler/runtime metadata.

harness.summary: Add differential fixtures for structural cyclic modules, acyclic eager values over cyclic link graphs, eager init-cycle rejection, and import/discovery-order perturbation; production/Ubuntu execution is required before promotion.

frank.summary: FRANK's recurrent/loop architecture must not be conflated with startup eager-value dependency cycles. Structural reciprocal references may remain cyclic while initialization/effect readiness stays explicitly phased and deterministic.

claygraph.summary: Represent structural import/link edges and eager initialization dependency edges as distinct typed relations; a structural SCC is not automatically an initialization failure.

unifieddb.summary: Where module runtime state is persisted, preserve module semantic identity, init-plan hash, init outcome/failure lineage and canonical cycle receipt without treating persistence as execution authority.

hyperposition.summary: Cyclic/higher-order structural topology can coexist with an acyclic activation/initialization projection; test whether this separation generalizes to other dynamic Clay topologies.

gwt.summary: No workspace mechanism change. Startup/link ordering should be controlled so it cannot masquerade as GWT causal variation.

emergenz.summary: No emergence claim. Initialization-order variation is a potential confound that later lesion/replay studies should control.

clayresearch.summary: Integrated architecture should distinguish persistent recurrent structure from one-time eager initialization dependencies; fewer deploy-time boundaries must not erase lifecycle-phase distinctions.
